description: Search the published content of www.accentvoice.com (pages, blog posts, products, customer stories). Plain questions work: filler words are ignored, results are ranked by how many terms match (title first), and broad questions return the overview pages. Returns up to `limit` results with collection, slug (absent for pages), route, title and score. Use site_get to read a result in full.
name: site_search
title: Search accentvoice.com
